# Sabbir Hasan

> CCNA-trained Network Engineer, Cybersecurity Specialist, and Full-Stack Developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Sabbir Hasan designs high-performance IT infrastructure, Cisco enterprise networks, secure web backends with Node.js and MySQL, and defensible digital systems. He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from Lovely Professional University.
